reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Minimal reconstitution, native cleavage comparison and CT mixing, size-selective intact-vesicle and planar-bilayer pore tests; conditional cofactor branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

explanation_reason: Sound biochemical sufficiency and physical pore discrimination; no claimed proof of exclusive cellular execution. Operational preparation, sample size, model diagnostics and full versioned audit remain incomplete.
historical_match_reason: The direct pore question/mechanism, purified authentic NT and cleavage/CT comparisons, controlled protein-free bilayers, conductance plus intact size-selective passage and conditional pore prediction jointly match. A cell bridge would strengthen physiological scope, but its absence does not erase the demonstrated minimal-reconstitution historical direction under the stated five-component rule.
